name: Run trace shows the Specs read chip and the Project context block's token attribution
description: Open the seeded PR #483, switch to Agent runs, open the seeded run's Trace drawer, expand Prompt assembly, and confirm the project-context rendering end to end: the Configuration section gains a 'Specs read' row whose chip carries the path AND its mechanical token estimate ('specs/api-layering.md · ≈144 tk'), and the Prompt assembly section shows the 'Project context (dynamic)' block WITH its '~158 tokens' attribution label — the chip and the block's token count are asserted TOGETHER by the final wait --fn, which walks to the prompt-row div holding the block label so the token figure is provably the Project context block's own (not the skills block's). The seeded run's trace was persisted with the path-labeled untrusted wrapper, specs_read, and specs_tokens (144 = ceil(576/4) doc chars; 158 = ceil(632/4) wrapped-block chars), so this pins AC-18's trace rendering with zero model calls. The chip itself may sit below the drawer's inner fold, so it is asserted over innerText, never --text; the expand is the flow-13 GUARDED wait --fn (coordinate clicks silently miss below the fold, and TraceSection children stay unmounted while collapsed). Labels are DOM-cased; never locate on Badge content.

cmd: Add refund endpoint with happy-path test
steps.label: open the seeded experiment PR #483
switch to the Agent runs tab
runs tab active in the URL
the seeded run's agent row renders
the Configuration section gains the Specs read row (the chip itself is asserted via innerText below — it can sit below the drawer fold)

cmd: () => { const el = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')).find((s) => s.textContent === 'Prompt assembly'); if (!el) return false; if (document.body.innerText.includes('User / diff')) return true; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); el.closest('div').click(); return false; }
steps.label: expand the collapsed Prompt assembly section (guarded click — coordinate clicks miss below the fold)

cmd: () => { const t = document.body.innerText; if (!/specs\/api-layering\.md\s*·\s*≈\s*144\s*tk/.test(t)) return false; const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('span')).find((s) => s.textContent === 'Project context (dynamic)'); if (!label) return false; const head = label.closest('div'); return !!head && /~\s*158\s*tokens/.test(head.textContent); }
steps.label: TOGETHER: the Specs read chip shows specs/api-layering.md · ≈144 tk, and the Project context (dynamic) block's own row carries its ~158 tokens attribution
